_note: Machine-readable contract for the Without Number core. Author direction 2026-10-26: use the CWN/SWN/AWN/WWN system for everything; stats, skills and all rules based on them. Implementation: src/rules/wn_core.py; ruling: docs/design/RULING_2026-10-26_WN_BASELINE.md; conversion record: docs/rules/CWN_CONVERSION.md.
_source_of_truth: data/rules/wn_core.json is the contract; src/rules/wn_core.py is the kernel; tests/test_wn_core_contract.py and tests/test_cwn_procedures.py assert they agree.

_sources.psionics_shape: Stars Without Number Revised (mechanics re-expressed; no text or tables copied - see docs/licenses/ISSUE_569_WITHOUT_NUMBER_RIGHTS.md)

skills.attribute_binding: none: the attribute is chosen per action, never fixed per skill

skill_check.formula: 2d6 + attribute modifier + skill level + situational + aid

saves.formula: d20 >= 16 - level - the highest of the two listed attribute modifiers
saves._note: CWN SRD 2.02 and 1.8.x. The earlier draft of this file had base 15 and no level term; both were wrong against the SRD and are corrected here. Luck carries no attribute modifiers. At level 1 the target is 15, which is the number the advancement chapter quotes.

attack.formula: d20 + attack bonus + attribute modifier + combat skill level
attack.success: total >= the relevant Melee or Ranged Armor Class
attack.attribute_choice: a weapon listing two attributes uses whichever modifier is better

armor_class.formula: armor's base AC for that kind + the wearer's DEX modifier
armor_class.note: a target may have two different ACs; the attack kind decides which one applies

damage.formula: weapon damage dice + the weapon's attribute modifier
damage.unarmed_skill_to_damage: Punch adds to a purely unarmed attack, never to artificial weaponry using Punch

soak.ablation: depleted for the rest of the fight

shock.condition: target melee AC <= the weapon's Shock AC rating, or the rating is unlimited
adds: bonuses that explicitly add to Shock
shock.floor: a hit can never do less damage than the Shock the same weapon would have inflicted on a miss

trauma.formula: if Trauma Die roll >= target Trauma Target then the hit's total damage is multiplied by the weapon's Trauma Rating
trauma.target_modifiers: armor, cyber and abilities may raise the Trauma Target
trauma.non_lethal: non-lethal attacks do not roll the Trauma Die

actions.move_as_main: a character may spend the Main action to take a second Move action
actions.on_turn_per_round: as many as the referee finds plausible
actions.instant_per_round: as many as the referee finds plausible

initiative.surprise: a wholly unaware side can lose a free round before initiative

mortal_injury.trigger: reduced to 0 hit points by a lethal attack

stabilize.difficulty: 8 + full rounds since the target fell
stabilize.attempts: one ally per round; may be retried each round

frail.removal: a week of bed rest with medical care
frail.field_attempt: DEX/Heal or INT/Heal difficulty 10 with a medkit and an hour
frail.while_frail: dropping to 0 hit points again is instant death

mortal_injury.non_lethal: 0 hit points from non-lethal damage is incapacitation for ten minutes, then 1 hit point, and no Frail
mortal_injury.npc: unnamed NPCs die at 0 hit points

major_injury.trigger: reduced to 0 hit points by lethal damage in the same scene as a Traumatic Hit
major_injury.on_success: Mortally Wounded but stabilizable and recoverable
major_injury.cyberware_damage: cyber in the ruined location is disabled until repaired (Fix-0 and Heal-0, one day per system, 20% of cost in parts)

strain.name: System Strain
strain.permanent: cyberware installation adds its System Strain as permanent Strain
strain.over_maximum: an unavoidable effect that forces the total over the maximum knocks the character unconscious for at least an hour
strain.blocks: an activation or drug that would exceed the maximum cannot be used
strain.recovery: one point is lost after each night's rest with eight uninterrupted hours

first_aid.frail: restores hit points but never removes Frailty

natural_healing.frail: no natural healing until Frailty is cured

frail_removal.without_care: a Physical save after a week; failure is death within the week, success loses Frailty after another month

poison.medic_bonus: twice Heal skill within a minute, or +1 with Heal-0 only

installation.failure_by_three_or_more: surgery fails, System Strain is maximized, the target drops to 1 hit point, and the cyber counts as used
installation.failure_by_one_or_two: surgery succeeds but the user takes a random implant complication

maintenance.work_hours: the system's System Strain, minimum fifteen minutes
maintenance.neglect: an implant complication applies until the system is maintained

alienation.note: the default CWN rule is that chrome alone causes no mechanical alienation; the alternate rule is recorded here and is off unless a campaign turns it on

access.formula: INT modifier + Program skill level + the cyberdeck's bonus Access
access.refresh: one hour of deck reprogramming, once per day
access.bonus: inside information can add network-specific Access and perishes within weeks

wireless.restriction: the avatar cannot leave the entry node

security_levels.8: small business, minor gang or minor government office
security_levels.9: corp branch office, major gang or important government facility

check.formula: 2d6 + INT modifier + Program skill level + verb modifier + situation

alert.window: up to an hour between the two alert actions

hit_points.per_level: 1d6 + CON modifier per character level; if the total does not exceed the current maximum, the maximum rises by 1

psionics._note: Shape from SWN Revised, mechanics re-expressed. No SWN text, power names or tables are reproduced; see docs/rules/CWN_CONVERSION.md and the rights audit. WWN's Effort pattern supplies the pool shape and is CC0.

effort.formula: 1 + max(WIS modifier, CON modifier) + the highest psionic skill level
effort.commitment: every power that requires Effort commits exactly one point
effort.refresh: all Effort returns after a good night's rest

torching.grants: one Effort for the rest of the scene, even above the maximum

progression.technique_gate: a technique may only be taken at or above its minimum skill level

discipline_structure.core_technique: one per discipline, automatic at level 0
discipline_structure.techniques: learned individually, one per skill level gained

npc.skill_checks: a flat bonus instead of attribute plus skill
npc.saves: no attribute modifiers unless the stat line says so

resolution_rules.determinism: every roll takes an injected rng or explicit dice values
